unresolved_mappings.title: Hysterectomy
unresolved_mappings.issue: WEAK mapping strength / no MCC objective addresses hysterectomy indications or complications directly; objective 112's (Abnormal Uterine Bleeding) management step for refractory bleeding is the nearest adjacent evidence.
unresolved_mappings.recommended_action: Retain current COMPONENT classification; revisit only if a dedicated procedural objective is added to the registry in a future refresh.

unresolved_mappings.title: Termination of Pregnancy
unresolved_mappings.issue: WEAK secondary evidence citing objective 81 (Early pregnancy loss/spontaneous abortion), whose title/rationale is scoped to spontaneous loss rather than induced/elective termination; the unit's primary evidence (121-1, Consent) is MODERATE.
unresolved_mappings.recommended_action: Retain CROSS_DISCIPLINE classification on the strength of 121-1; revisit if a future registry refresh adds an abortion/pregnancy-termination-specific objective.

unresolved_mappings.title: Bartholin Gland Abscess
unresolved_mappings.issue: No MCC objective addresses Bartholin gland abscess or vulvar abscess; nearest candidates (Pelvic pain, Abdominal/pelvic masses) describe a different anatomic presentation and were deliberately not cited to avoid overreach.
unresolved_mappings.recommended_action: Revisit if a future MCC objectives-registry refresh adds a vulvar/Bartholin-specific objective.

unresolved_mappings.title: Gynecologic Surgical Site Infections
unresolved_mappings.issue: No MCC objective specifically addresses post-gynecologic-surgical infection; general surgical-site-infection competencies are expected to be covered more fully under the completed GS (General and Thoracic Surgery) chapter crosswalk.
unresolved_mappings.recommended_action: Defer to the global chapter-overlap audit against GS's crosswalk; revisit if a gynecology-specific surgical-infection objective is added.

unresolved_mappings.title: Vulvar Cancer
unresolved_mappings.issue: Primary evidence (113, Vaginal discharge/vulvar pruritus, MODERATE) is adequate, but a secondary WEAK citation to objective 2 (Abdominal masses and pelvic masses) was retained as loosely analogous supporting context for the mass/lesion angle.
unresolved_mappings.recommended_action: Retain; the WEAK secondary citation does not change the unit's overall COMPONENT classification, which rests on the MODERATE primary evidence.

unresolved_mappings.title: Vaginal Cancer
unresolved_mappings.issue: Primary vaginal cancer is rare and not named in any retrieved MCC objective; abnormal vaginal bleeding (objective 112) is the only adjacent evidence found, at WEAK strength.
unresolved_mappings.recommended_action: Retain minimal (coverage_weight 1) COMPONENT classification; revisit if a future registry refresh adds site-specific gynecologic-oncology objectives.

note: 6 unit(s) carry WEAK/flagged mapping_strength or classification UNCERTAIN with no attached MCC evidence, out of 39 total study units.
